channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — magictools
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: GameSkill — via magictools
item.description: Curated catalog of 145+ game development agent skills (SKILL.md) and MCP servers for Godot, Unity, Unreal, Blender, and Phaser, plus 16 zero-login interactive browser labs covering combat juice, shaders, AI video-to-sprite pipelines, puzzle solvers, and roguelike math. Free MIT skills and labs; optional Pro packs.

item.title: Circuit UI SFX Free Sample — via magictools
item.description: 12 CC0 procedural retro game sound effects in WAV, plus a free browser-based retro sound generator.

item.title: Tyrbo — via magictools
item.description: AI agent that makes mobile games from a description: plans the game with concept art, builds it with its art, 2D and 3D animation and sound, tests it by playing it, and runs it on your phone from a QR code.

item.title: SpriteForge Pixel Art Normal Map — via magictools
item.description: Free browser normal map generator for pixel art sprites and sheets, with a moving-light preview and per-colour height; PNG for Unity and Godot, nothing uploaded.

item.title: SpriteForge Pixel Art Maker — via magictools
item.description: Free browser pixel art editor with layers, animation frames and onion skin, Aseprite-style keys, and PNG, GIF, sprite sheet or .aseprite export; no account.

item.title: SpriteForge Image to Pixel Art — via magictools
item.description: Free browser image-to-pixel-art converter: 16-128 px wide, 4-32 colours or palettes like PICO-8, dithering and outline; PNG download, nothing uploaded.

item.title: RFTracks — via magictools
item.description: Royalty free music for games made with AI tools, filterable by mood, genre and tempo, MP3 downloads; free for commercial games with a credit link to RFTracks, paid plans without credit.

item.title: RBXGFX — via magictools
item.description: AI generator for 1920x1080 Roblox game thumbnails and 512x512 icons that produces multiple distinct compositions per request, plus free browser-based Roblox image resizer and safe-zone preview utilities (5 free signup credits; paid plans available; not affiliated with Roblox Corporation).

item.title: Overheard Calendar — via magictools
item.description: Submission deadlines for indie game festivals, showcases, awards, Steam events and funds, each checked on the organiser's page

item.title: Mint Polycount Checker — via magictools
item.description: Check a GLB/glTF model's triangles, vertices, draw calls and texture memory against game budgets (including Roblox's per-mesh limit) in the browser; free, no signup, nothing uploaded.

item.title: CSAF Music Library — via magictools
item.description: 2,618 royalty free game music tracks in 59 albums, OGG and editable MIDI, with a free demo of one full track from every album. Composed by code written with AI tools, with no generative audio model.

item.title: Apps66 Game Audio Converter — via magictools
item.description: Online vgmstream + FFmpeg decoder for FMOD FSB5, Wwise WEM/BNK, Nintendo BFSTM/BCSTM/BRSTM, CRIWARE HCA/ADX/AWB, and XACT XWB sound banks to WAV/MP3/OGG/FLAC/M4A with audio preview and multi-track ZIP extraction (free tier up to 50 MB / 3 conversions per 24h).

item.title: Open Web Arcade — via magictools
item.description: Free directory of open-source browser games; developers list a link or upload a zip up to 50 MB to run sandboxed.

item.title: Ember Audio Free Sampler — via magictools
item.description: 30 game audio files in OGG, with one music track, one seamless ambience loop and one SFX from each of 10 settings (dungeon, cyberpunk, cozy farm, western, cosmic horror, tavern, sci-fi, feudal Japan, post-apocalypse, pirates); royalty-free for commercial use, no attribution required. AI-generated (Suno for music, Stable Audio Open for loops and SFX) and hand-curated.

item.title: neme.world — via magictools
item.description: Publish browser games with version history, rollback, player feedback, and playtest reports.

item.title: SteamScout Indie Dev Workbench — via magictools
item.description: 30 free, no-login browser tools for Steam indie devs: 14-region pricing matrix (with Poland PLN fix), 30-day discount cooldown planner, W-8BEN tax & publisher deal calculators, local capsule resizer/previewer, BBCode editor, SteamPipe VDF generator, and 60-item pre-launch QA checklist.

item.title: SpriteSheet.dev — via magictools
item.description: Browser tools that pack frames or a GIF into a sprite sheet (named animations per row, per-frame timing kept, pivot written to the data) with TexturePacker JSON, Aseprite JSON or Sparrow XML using FNF frame names, cut sheets back into frames by grid, data file or automatically, and turn sheets into GIFs. Exports tested loading in Phaser 3.90/4.2 and PixiJS 8.22. Files stay on your device.

item.title: JadeRealms — via magictools
item.description: Free GLB/Blender game models with browser previews; AI-assisted JadeRealms assets use custom commercial-use terms restricting raw redistribution. Other collections keep their source licenses.

item.title: Genex — via magictools
item.description: Open-source desktop app where AI agents set up Unreal Engine, Unity, Godot, Roblox or Three.js, build the game, play-test it and publish it to Mac, Windows, Linux and the web. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity (Gemini models), OpenCode or local models.

item.title: AvatarSay Fantasy NPC Generator — via magictools
item.description: Browser-based fantasy and RPG NPC character generator with randomized ancestry, roles, traits, and portrait prompts for game development and tabletop campaigns (no signup required).

item.title: Sprite Sheet Slicer — via magictools
item.description: Slice a sprite sheet by grid or cell size, preview the animation, and export PNG frames plus a Godot- and Unity-friendly JSON atlas.

item.title: Puff — via magictools
item.description: Preview pixel-art explosions and spell hits in the browser. The paid offline tool exports PNG sprite sheets, Godot 4 SpriteFrames and RPG Maker MV/MZ animations.

item.title: Game SFX Loudness Normalizer & Preview — via magictools
item.description: Measure peak, RMS and BS.1770 loudness of game SFX, preview a normalize, and download a WAV, all in your browser.

item.title: Voidless Voxel Editor — via magictools
item.description: Browser voxel editor with box, line and mirror tools. Exports MagicaVoxel .vox, GLB, OBJ and PNG, and renders 8-direction pixel art sprites. No account needed.

item.title: Voidless Sprite Sheet Tools — via magictools
item.description: Free browser sprite sheet cutter/slicer and packer: cut a sheet into frames, or pack sprites into one atlas with PNG and Phaser/PixiJS JSON output. No account needed; files stay in the browser.

item.title: Voidless 8-Bit Sound Generator — via magictools
item.description: sfxr-style retro sound effect generator that runs in the browser. No account needed.

item.title: Voidless — via magictools
item.description: AI game assets: pixel art sprites from 32 to 384 px, sprite animation, 8-direction sprites, tilesets, 3D models, sound and music. Includes an MCP server so Claude Code or Cursor can generate art straight into a project. 60 free credits on sign-up, no subscription.

item.title: Verdant 00 Free Tileset Sampler — via magictools
item.description: 878 top down 16x16 pixel art tiles, including 16 complete 47 mask autotile sets, with importers for RPG Maker MZ, Tiled and Godot; royalty free for commercial use, no credit required. Drawn by a procedural pixel engine written with an AI assistant, no image generators.

item.title: Trify3D — via magictools
item.description: Browser-based AI 3D generator that runs Tripo3D, Meshy and Rodin side by side and exports game-ready GLB and OBJ assets.

item.title: SpritePacker — via magictools
item.description: Free browser sprite sheet packer with Compact (MaxRects), Grid, Horizontal and Vertical layouts, padding, extrude and trim. Exports PNG sheets with JSON Hash (Phaser, PixiJS), TexturePacker Generic XML or CSS/SCSS, or as an animated GIF. Frames are packed on your device; no account needed.

item.title: SceneCrate Free 3D Game Assets — via magictools
item.description: Nine walkable CC0 1.0 3D browser-game scenes (buildings, heightfield terrain, and static props) in two measured GLB tiers, with JSON colliders and offline Three.js examples; no account required.

item.title: Overture Free Game Music Sampler — via magictools
item.description: 68 game music tracks from 34 albums (fantasy, retro, horror, science fiction, cozy) as OGG, 67 of them with loop points in the file, plus the MIDI source of every track; royalty free for commercial use, no credit required. Composed by code written with an AI assistant, no AI audio models.

item.title: MakerGIF Sprite Sheet Converter — via magictools
item.description: Free browser-based GIF and short-video to PNG sprite sheet converter with live WASD animation playtesting, Phaser 3 JSON, and Sparrow v2 XML export; files stay on your device with no account required.

item.title: Iconito Game Food Icons — via magictools
item.description: Food icons for cooking, farming and cozy games, free under the MIT license as SVG, in Figma and on Iconify.

item.title: Gridize — via magictools
item.description: AI pixel art sprite and animation generator: make sprites from a prompt or upload your own, animate idle, attack, spell and turnaround clips of 9 to 49 frames on one consistent pixel grid, and export GIF, WebP, PNG frames or sprite sheets with timing JSON. Free credits on signup.

item.title: Fright Queue Horror Jam Tracker — via magictools
item.description: Nightly-updated tracker of horror game jams on itch.io

item.title: Fright Queue Dev Planner — via magictools
item.description: Steam sale and festival calendar for indie devs, with 30-day discount cooldown windows to plan launches and discounts

item.title: Fantasy RPG SFX Bundle — via magictools
item.description: 763 royalty-free combat, magic and loot/UI sounds in WAV and OGG. Combat is edited from CC0 Freesound recordings (mostly real Foley; some designed-sound sources and light synth layers); magic and loot/UI are synthesized in code; AI helped with tooling and text.

item.title: CC0 Materials — via magictools
item.description: Free CC0 PBR textures for game environments, up to 4K with OpenGL and DirectX normal maps for Unity, Unreal and Godot.

item.title: 8-Bit Arcade SFX Free Lite — via magictools
item.description: 24 free 8-bit sound effects (UI, coins, jumps, lasers, jingles) synthesized by code; free for commercial use, no attribution required.

item.title: Markan — via magictools
item.description: Steam market research for indie games: Google Sheets and Excel add-ins that pull Steam data and estimate sales, free pages for about 80,000 games and 420 tags, and a free MCP server so AI assistants can find similar games and estimate their sales. No account needed.

item.title: GIF to Sprite Sheet — via magictools
item.description: Browser tool that turns a GIF, animated WebP or video into a PNG sprite sheet, with JSON atlas, Godot .tres and Sparrow XML export. Also cuts sheets into frames and plays a sheet back as a GIF. Files stay on your device.

item.title: Pixelorama — via magictools
item.description: Free & open source pixel art editor with animation support, made with Godot.

item.title: Gridwright — via magictools
item.description: Pixel-art asset packs drawn on one grid, plus 31 browser tools for tilesets, maps, sprite sheets, effects and sound.

item.title: Claude Game Studio — via magictools
item.description: Claude Code plugin for making browser games: 10 tested genre starters, 123 models, 43 materials, 13 skies, and skills to design, build, playtest and fix. The kit is $29 a year; the pixel art maker, game idea generator and design document template on the site are free.

item.title: CSAF Sound Library — via magictools
item.description: 13,315 royalty free game sound effects in 91 packs, WAV and OGG, with a free demo download. Every sound is synthesized in code with no samples or generative audio model; the code was written with AI tools.

item.title: 3DLoom — via magictools
item.description: Image or text to textured 3D game assets, exported as GLB, FBX, OBJ or USDZ, with a low-poly mode for props. 20 free credits on sign-up and no subscription; the GLB, OBJ and FBX converters are free and need no account.

item.title: Animate4Me — via magictools
item.description: Turns a text prompt or an image into a Spine 4.2 animation with bones and weighted meshes for 2D game symbols, objects and characters; previews in the browser and exports skeleton.json, atlas and PNG pages.

item.title: klad — via magictools
item.description: Drawing and animation app for 2D game art that people and coding agents edit together: every stroke and fill stays editable data, pixel layers, tilesets with Godot TileSet export, Aseprite in and out, sprite sheet and GIF export, and MIT agent skills that teach any agent to paint and judge drawing and pixel art. Free for personal use and small companies. Source

item.title: PlayDrop — via magictools
item.description: Make a browser game by describing it, or publish one your AI app made, and share it with a link.
